text:
Alex: FYI pushed strict schema validation for fn/tool calls to 100% in eu-west at 14:02 UTC and now seeing a bunch of rejects + customer errors. Console 'tool errors' chart looks unchanged though — might be telemetry gap. anyone oncall?

Maya: I'm digging logs. Rejections are `invalid_shape` from the validator service. Many are where model returned an array instead of the expected object. sample: 
```json
{"error":"invalid_schema","path":"/response","expected":"object","got":"array"}
```

Sam: hmm, routing policy for strict rollout should have routed traffic to permissive fallback when validator rejects. logs show requests got 200 but then dropped later in proxy. maybe our post-processing stripped the `tool_call` envelope.

Alex: that would explain console not reflecting increase — dashboard reads from aggregated `tool_errors` metric emitted at post-process, if post-process crashes we never emit.

Rui: I see two failure modes in traces: 1) validator rejects and returns 400 early (metric emitted), 2) post-process raises on shape mismatch and we swallow before metric. looks like only 1 is covered by current metric.

Tess: can we add a low-cardinality metric `invoke.reject_reason` (values: invalid_schema, postproc_error, timeout) tagged by `route` and `model_variant`? need for alerts and rollout gating.

Sam: +1. Also add a sampled payload log (scrubbed) for rejects so we can triage shapes without hitting PII. maybe 1 in 1000 sample with a flag `sampled_reject=true`.

Maya: quick patch idea: when post-process fails, increment `postproc_error` and emit the original payload into the debug sink. I'll prototype a tiny wrapper.

Alex: big question — do we rollback strict validation now or keep for further telemetry? Product is seeing production errors.

Tess: short term rollback to 50% and enable the extra metrics+sampling. we can then re-run a 25% ramp with dashboard visibility.

Rui: agree. Also suggest console UX change: show `reject_rate` per rollout slice (canary/perm) and include a link to a sampled payload viewer. Right now ops has to hop between traces and logs.

Sam: note on quotas — these rejects count against customer quota in current billing pipeline. we should not bill for rejected invokes. opened an issue in billing: BILL-478 to exempt `invalid_schema` and `postproc_error` states.

eng-bot: canary-rollback job queued by Tess — rollback to 50% started. job id cj-9832.

Maya: I'm attaching a short list of distinct shapes causing the validator to fail (copied-snippets):
- array-of-objects instead of single object for `tool_output`
- `null` where `object` required
- extra top-level `metadata` string, validator schema expects `meta:{...}`

Alex: action items:
- Tess: own dashboard changes (per-route reject_rate + sampled payload link) — ETA EOD tomorrow
- Maya: prototype postproc wrapper that emits `postproc_error` + sampled payload — PR by EOD today
- Sam: coordinate with billing to stop counting rejects — pinged billing on BILL-478
- Rui: add `invoke.reject_reason` metric definition and wire into metric infra

Tess: grabbing this. will file dashboard ticket and include a small explainer for PMs so they don't confuse reject_rate with model quality.

Alex: thanks. let's pause strict rollout until dashboards & billing exemption are live. I'll post an update to the release thread after rollback finishes. :thumbsup:

eng-bot: rollback job cj-9832 completed at 14:25 UTC, strict-validation set to 50% for eu-west.

Maya: confirming we see reject_count drop ~60% after rollback in raw logs. Will keep sampling and share examples in the thread.
